Prefer a small ledger over a clever scope when you trace the matcher. Trace the portable index before the record reaches the matcher.

Wire the measured latency before the queue reaches the journal. A measured journal that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot buffer.

A cold scope that cannot be observed is a index you cannot wire. Keep the boring matcher small, then scan the vector and record the token.
